title: habits/0.1 habit
description: Structure of a habit file (assets/reflex.yml, or the scenario given to habit_run): top-level fields, node shapes, exits, modifiers, limits, trigger forms and name patterns. It does not check the graph itself: the validator (habits/graph.py, validate) remains the authority and also checks rule 1 (every node reachable from start), rule 2 (every exit leads to an existing node), rule 3 (no loop), rule 4 (fallback names a wake node), rule 6 (every choice or score option appears in then, keys compared as text), that every variable used is defined somewhere, that no template sits inside quotes in a terminal command, and the safety checks (no deletion, no free-code tool, read: true only reads, no llm value in a terminal command). Use depth and budgets spent by sub-habits are checked at run time. Other top-level keys are ignored by the validator, so they are allowed here. See SPEC.md.

inputs.description: Variables given by the caller (habit_run inputs, or the with of a use node).

fallback.description: The wake node that ends every run that goes wrong.

allOf.description: A watch runs unattended: 60 seconds and 20 tool calls at most per check.

reserved.description: Set by the runner; as and inputs must not use them.

path.description: A variable, optionally followed by fields or list indexes: files, page.title, rows.0.

trigger.description: Absent or null: a one-off scenario or a sub-habit.

oneOf.description: Request: the user's message matches the habit.
Watch: every interval, a whole number of minutes, hours or days (5m, 2h, 1d); every: 1d may add a time of day, 24-hour and quoted (at: "21:00").

limits.description: Budgets per run. Defaults: 120 s, 200 steps, 100 tools, 300 questions, 5 llm calls (watch: 60 s, 20 tools).

option.description: An answer; a whole number is read as its digits.

score.description: Levels from lowest to highest. A mapping is accepted; its descriptions are not sent.

as.description: Store the node's result in this variable.

each.description: Repeat the node for each item of this list variable (a text is split into lines).

where.description: With each: keep the items whose value of the variable equals the value, compared as text.

with.description: Variables given to the node: state of an ask or llm, inputs of a use, values returned by end or wake.

node.description: Exactly one verb: ask, check, do, llm, use, end or wake.

ask.description: A typed question to a decision model. Exactly one answer type. Without each: then (one exit per answer, plus optional unsure) or next. With each: next only. With pick: next, and an optional unsure exit.

pick.description: Choose ONE item of this list (or table) variable in one choice question whose options are the items, "none" last (254 items at most): as gets the item.

margin.description: With pick: how far the top item's probability must stand over the second's (0.15 unless given).

unsure.description: With pick: the node when no item is sure and clear (else the fallback).

doubts.description: With each only: an item the decision model is unsure about is left out (shown in the report), not a doubt that hands the run back.

check.description: A computed condition; no model is called. Both exits are required.

do.description: Call a Hermes tool through the normal tool path. read: true only for a call that only reads.

llm.description: One structured LLM call, with no tool. Without schema the value is one string.

use.description: Run another habit in the caller's mode and budgets; its end becomes the value, its wake takes the error exit.

end.description: Finish with a report. Reached with doubts, it becomes a wake.

wake.description: Finish and wake the LLM with what was done and why.
